question: How many recognised essential vitamins are there as on March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**13. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• There are 13 essential vitamins — vitamins **A, C, D, E, K, and the B vitamins (thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, pantothenic acid, biotin, B6, B12, and folate).**

 
• Vitamins and minerals are considered essential nutrients because acting in concert, they perform hundreds of roles in the body. 
 
• They **help shore up bones, heal wounds, and bolster your immune system****​**.
